contract.initialization: A completed value is owned before initializer temporary or lexical cleanup. Exceptions destroy it once. Partially initialized arrays destroy only the completed prefix in reverse order. Failed result storage is cleared after normal cleanup. Jumps cannot bypass managed initialization.
contract.runtime_identity: v9 nominal ownership encodings and Block copy/dispose helper identities; weak storage remains address-stable.
boundaries: public Optional/Result and synchronous throws syntax remain reserved
